name: dark-gothic-doll
image_purpose: gothic hair, dress, bedroom, and styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic bedroom portrait of an approved adult woman with a gothic doll-inspired aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long black hair in two braids and soft bangs, defined eyeliner, long lashes, nude-pink lips, wearing a black dress with a white collar, short sleeves, and secure coverage, plus opaque black tights.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated gracefully on a bed with dark floral cushions, elegant bedroom, chandelier, framed artwork, mysterious confident expression, no lace thigh-high emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor light with gentle shadows, elegant gothic bedroom mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic lifestyle portrait, portrait 4:5, natural skin texture, sharp hair and dress detail, realistic proportions.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long black braided hair and bangs sits on a bed with dark floral cushions, wearing a black short-sleeve dress with a white collar and opaque black tights. Use defined eyeliner, nude-pink lips, elegant gothic bedroom decor, chandelier, framed artwork, soft light, and a mysterious confident expression. No lace thigh-highs or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lace thigh-highs, garter, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
